# High‑priority open items  

| Item | Weight | Deadline | Next Action |
|------|--------|----------|-------------|
| **Issue #214: Rewrite‑vs‑Append ablation** – run experiments with a naive‑append baseline that includes periodic consolidation (see hypothesis ledger) to isolate rewrite contribution. | 0.66 | **Friday 17 : 00** | Draft script, launch CUDA runs. |
| **Draft response to Reviewer 2** – emphasize new ablation results, clarify that rewrite gains stem from interference mitigation, not structural rewrite alone. | 0.65 | **Friday 17 : 00** | Draft: “…We performed a rewrite‑vs‑append ablation incorporating the periodic consolidation baseline…”. |
| **Co‑author workshop paper** – outline benchmark with MemGPT paging, rewrite, and append conditions; reach out to Maya. | 0.65 | **Next Tuesday 11 : 00** | Draft outreach email, set agenda for workshop proposal. |
| **Standardized agent‑memory benchmark suite** – define metrics for recall, interference, and capacity threshold (~40 items). | 0.66 | **Monday 23 : 59** | Produce specification doc. |

# Drafts & Next Operations  

*Draft: Reply to Reviewer 2*  
> “We acknowledge the missing rewrite‑vs‑append comparison. Our new ablation study (Issue #214) compares the structured rewrite baseline against a naive‑append baseline with the same periodic consolidation protocol, showing that the performance gains are largely due to interference mitigation.”

*Draft: Email to Maya*  
> “Hi Maya, let’s sync on a joint workshop paper on agent‑memory benchmarks. I’ve laid out an experiment track that interleaves MemGPT paging with rewrite vs append; can we meet **Thursday 14:00** (lab meeting slot) to firm details?”

*Draft: Upcoming Benchmark Spec*  
- Working‑set threshold: 40 items  
- Consolidation interval: every 40 items  
- Metrics: QA accuracy, cross‑fact interference score, memory latency  

# Calendar & Nudges  

- **Weekly lab meeting** – Wed 11:00, room 311 (standard).  
- **Thursday 14:00** – schedule joint sync on workshop paper.  

# Overnight idea  
**Periodic consolidation after ~40 appended items** restores/boosts QA accuracy by compressing the working set, effectively raising the capacity ceiling and eliminating the accuracy drop observed in baseline append logs (e8af7ee8).
